title: Case 033: Reported loss of property from a rented home
initial_request: My tenant has told me that belongings are missing from my property at 133 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 6ZZ. Please help me establish the facts and pass the matter to my insurer.
overview: The tenant first told Rhys Turner that belongings appeared to be missing, without confirming a complete list or when they were last seen. Rhys reported this to Phoebe at Amberley Cover, who requested factual details, any information about contact with the police, and confirmation that access to the home was secure. Rhys then provided the available account without suggesting who might be responsible. Phoebe sent the information to Northmere Mutual and confirmed the submission to Rhys; no registration or decision from the insurer is recorded.

next_action.summary: At escalation, ask Rhys what items are missing, when they were noticed, what is known about the circumstances and whether the property is secure; then send the qualified account to the insurer.

outcome: The claim information has been submitted to Northmere Mutual; no insurer registration or decision has been reported.

events.body: I have noticed that some of your belongings appear to be missing from the house at 133 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 6ZZ. I do not yet know the full list or when the items were last there.

My tenant has reported that belongings are missing from my property at 133 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 6ZZ. I do not yet have a complete list or a clear account of when the loss was discovered; could you advise what information you need to pass this on?

Please send the date the items were noticed missing, a list of what is missing, and what the tenant knows about when they were last seen and the circumstances. Please also share any information available about whether the police were contacted, if applicable, and let me know whether the home and its access points are secure; avoid investigating any potentially unsafe area yourself.

The tenant says a television from the sitting room and a cordless drill from the utility cupboard are missing; they last remember seeing them earlier in the week and noticed the loss while tidying, but cannot yet give an exact discovery date. They report no obvious sign of forced entry, but I cannot confirm how the items went missing; the tenant says they contacted the police and is checking whether an incident reference was provided, and the home is currently secure.

I am submitting Rhys Turner's report concerning missing property at 133 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 6ZZ. The tenant reports a missing television and cordless drill, an unknown exact discovery date and uncertain last-seen time, no obvious sign of forced entry, and contact with the police, with an incident reference not yet available; the circumstances and responsibility remain unconfirmed.

I have sent the information you provided to Northmere Mutual for its consideration. This confirms that the claim information has been submitted; I have not received confirmation of registration or a decision from the insurer.
